newsitem.title: CHINA: RESEARCH ALERT - China's Haixin kept a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - China's Haixin kept a buy.

text.p: Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co, China's biggest brokerage, on Tuesday reaffirmed a "buy" on textile producer Shanghai Haixin Co Ltd due to its positive earnings prospects.
Haixin recently posted net profits of 45.876 million yuan for the first half of 1997, up 75 percent compared with the same period last year, a company statement has said.

The company, which makes plush material for stuffed toys and other products, has found buyers for all of its 1997 output as well as its first quarter output in 1998, Shenyin & Wanguo said in a research report.
Haixin bought raw materials in the first half of this year when prices were relatively low to prepare for the peak production season in the second half, it said.
"After continued investment over the past few years, Haixin has entered a period of growth, which makes it worth buying as a long-term investment," the research report said.
Haixin has targeted a net profit of 115 million yuan for 1997, up from 75.139 million yuan in 1996, the company has said.
